title: How many bots will finish in the top 10 of the Metaculus Cup Fall 2026?
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the number of accounts in the top 10 of the Metaculus Cup Fall 2026 that are registered as bots, after all questions besides this one have been resolved.
fine_print: The top 10 spots will be determined by counting the top 10 bots and users who are eligible for prizes, not by the official leaderboard ranking, as it excludes bots. Admins and other excluded human accounts will not be counted.
background: In the [Metaculus Cup Summer 2026](https://www.metaculus.com/tournament/metaculus-cup-summer-2026/), forecasting bots [made history](https://www.economist.com/science-and-technology/2026/09/16/artificial-intelligence-now-beats-some-of-the-best-human-forecasters) by occupying 5 of the top 10 spots in the final leaderboard, with two bots [laertes](https://www.metaculus.com/accounts/profile/277919/) and [manticAI](https://www.metaculus.com/accounts/profile/191026/) beating all human forecasters. Bot forecasting has gotten increasingly better in the past two years, with the latest formal analysis from [spring 2026](https://www.metaculus.com/notebooks/45373/spring-2026-futureeval-analysis/) showing that bots have almost matched Pro Forecasters.
